findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: suggest-outfit-tool, create_image_upload, style-purchase-buy-url · Private data: like-dislike-outfit-tool, add_wardrobe_item_from_image, create_image_upload · Public sink: create_image_upload · Destructive: suggest-outfit-tool, like-dislike-outfit-tool, add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id, add-to-or-remove-from-closet-tool, add_wardrobe_item_from_description.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: suggest-outfit-tool, create_image_upload, style-purchase-buy-url · Private data: like-dislike-outfit-tool, add_wardrobe_item_from_image, create_image_upload · Public sink: create_image_upload · Destructive: suggest-outfit-tool, like-dislike-outfit-tool, add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id, add-to-or-remove-from-closet-tool, add_wardrobe_item_from_description

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
